tasks.title: Let ABC be an acute-angled triangle with AB 6= AC. The circle with…
tasks.statement:
Let ABC be an acute-angled triangle with AB 6= AC. The
circle with diameter BC intersects the sides AB and AC at M and N
respectively. Denote by O the midpoint of the side BC. The bisectors of
the angles 6 BAC and 6 M ON intersect at R. Prove that the circumcircles
of the triangles BM R and CN R have a common point lying on the side
BC.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).
parts.reference:
1. Let ABC be an acute-angled triangle with AB 6= AC. The circle with
   diameter BC intersects the sides AB and AC at M and N , respectively.
   Denote by O the midpoint of BC. The bisectors of the angles BAC and
   M ON intersect at R. Prove that the circumcircles of the triangles BM R
   and CN R have a common point lying on the line segment BC.

tasks.title: Find all polynomials f with real coefficients such that for all reals…
tasks.statement:
Find all polynomials f with real coefficients such that for all
reals a,b,c such that ab + bc + ca = 0 we have the following relations

                f (a − b) + f (b − c) + f (c − a) = 2f (a + b + c).

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).
parts.reference:
2. Find all polynomials P (x) with real coefficients that satisfy the equality

                 P (a − b) + P (b − c) + P (c − a) = 2P (a + b + c)

    for all triples a, b, c of real numbers such that ab + bc + ca = 0.

bisect the angles ABC and CDA. The point P lies inside ABCD and
satisfies
                  6 P BC = 6 DBA and 6 P DC = 6 BDA.

tasks.title: We call a positive integer alternating if every two consecutive…
tasks.statement:
We call a positive integer alternating if every two consecutive
digits in its decimal representation are of different parity.
Find all positive integers n such that n has a multiple which is alternating.

                                     2
